label: Spring playground
desc: Three sliders (stiffness, damping, mass) drive a live spring on a ball and a plotted response curve, with presets and the settle time.
use: landing page feature explainer, docs or about page showing how the motion feels

label: Layout gallery
desc: A grid of cards where the clicked card expands into a detail panel with a FLIP shared-element animation; Esc closes and focus returns.
use: landing page features, portfolio or project list, publishing list with detail view

label: Gesture card
desc: A card with hover lift, press-down scale (pointer or Space/Enter) and drag with momentum that coasts inside its boundary and settles on a spring.
use: landing page hero decoration, playful dashboard tile, connect page

label: Scroll linked
desc: A scroll-progress bar, a parallax layer and a percentage readout that follow the scroll position of a scrollable stage.
use: long-form landing sections, changelog or terms panel, reading progress inside a card

label: Presence list
desc: A list where added items animate in, removed items animate out before unmounting and the others slide into place; changes are announced.
use: dashboard task or notification list, publishing queue, settings lists

label: Spring toggle
desc: A role=switch whose thumb moves and squishes with spring physics, plus a spring-driven checkbox variant.
use: dashboard settings, sign-in remember-me, connect page options

label: Drag reorder
desc: A vertically reorderable list: drag by a handle while the others spring out of the way, or pick up with Space and move with the arrow keys.
use: dashboard priorities, publishing list ordering, onboarding checklist
